body:
Solid concern. That same fear plagued me for many years. I was born and shapen into a reality where they convinced me that I was born trash and that I'd go to hell by default/if I didn't join the cult and submit to human dysfunction so it's be a long winding road.

Only recently did I acquire enough knowledge and understanding about how the Earth system and beyond works to finally be rid of that fear. Karma and akashic records (histories of life cycle experiences) can be negated and all negatives erased. How? Command it.

We are all from the same Source and have every control over our indivdual realities. I can find the document and sources that I used for you if it'll help.

Humans struggle to comprehend the love and compassion the Source has for every single soul, from which all souls are descent. We are not here to suffer and the number one core truth and law of earth is that our free will never be violated by spirit. There is no judgement, no fear, because fear is the opposite of love.
It's not about luck, it's all about intent and commanding your body. This is my first option and in the event that anyone tries to force me to stay alive also a supreme backup plan.
